audit.method: Four read-only source, latency, graph, and user-story audits. Code and repository contracts were inspected. No live owner journey or provider flow was executed for this audit.
audit.confidenceMeaning: Confidence measures how strongly cited evidence supports the stated implementation status, not the probability that a personal fact is true or the percentage of the product completed.

productTruth.currentBoundary: Seven admitted source kinds can update an encrypted owner inventory and derived Profile memory.md while an owner client is open and unlocked. The source and connector journals contain change hints, not the values or full action history.
productTruth.uatBoundary: A healthy UAT release receipt exists for the earlier revision. It proves release health and provenance, not any real-owner capture story or a deployed freshness service level.

terminology.memory.datmd: No literal memory.datmd identifier was found in the audited repository. The closest chat authority is encrypted one_memory.markdown, called Soul.md internally. Profile memory.md is a distinct encrypted, derived document. Neither is a complete personal action log.
terminology.PWM: The legacy /api/pwm preference document and the native researched Personal World Model are different authorities. Neither is automatically a Live Memory source.
terminology.knowledgeGraph: The shipped living fact index has field nodes and provenance but no persisted subject→claim→evidence relationship graph or One-chat retrieval from that index.
terminology.documentationDrift: The older freshness ADR calls a value-bearing event journal proposed and says its worker/cursor do not exist. Migration 345 and the bridge now implement a narrower metadata-hint journal and encrypted cursor. Read these as distinct contracts, not contradictory runtime claims.

coverageMatrixLegend.yes: A direct implementation path was found in audited code; real delivery still needs a journey receipt
coverageMatrixLegend.partial: Only the stated subset or wake mechanism exists
coverageMatrixLegend.separate: A different memory or product authority exists, without a Live Memory inventory path
coverageMatrixLegend.no: No admitted path was found in the audited contract and code
coverageMatrixLegend.unverified: No real-source journey receipt was reviewed

coverageMatrix.surface: Full contact list and mail activity

nodeTypes.goal: Desired outcome, never evidence of implementation
nodeTypes.story: User-observable outcome with a real-data acceptance test
nodeTypes.gap: An unmet contract or observed implementation mismatch

edgeTypes.contains: Goal or story decomposes into a smaller story
edgeTypes.implemented_by: Component contributes to a story, without implying full completion
edgeTypes.blocked_by: Gap prevents the story's complete acceptance
edgeTypes.feeds: One component supplies a derived input to another
edgeTypes.separate_from: Stores or authorities must not be treated as equivalent

nodes.title: Inspectable, continuously updated owner memory
nodes.desiredOutcome: Every explicitly admitted durable owner change can be traced from its committed authority to a private, correctable memory claim, with measured freshness, lifecycle controls, and scoped access.

nodes.title: Profile rename and photo
nodes.want: my committed name and photo changes to replace the current version in Profile memory
nodes.soThat: my current identity is accurate after restart
substories: old in-flight read cannot restore the prior value
nodes.acceptance: With a consenting test owner, save a real rename and photo, inspect the authoritative owner response and encrypted readback, then retry a stale read. Check owner isolation and no inferred age or sex.
nodes.shippedSubset: Name, photo and email from effective owner identity; owner-scoped hint and snapshot path.
nodes.unmet: Other Profile and onboarding fields are not automatically part of this source; no real-flow receipt in this audit.

nodes.title: Onboarding and preference history
nodes.want: saved onboarding choices and corrections to appear with their exact authority and current state
nodes.soThat: my private agent does not confuse setup state with durable facts
substories: record saved preferred name and reply style
distinguish skipped setup questions from known facts
correct or erase a saved preference
nodes.acceptance: Complete and then correct real onboarding choices. Verify which values entered encrypted PKM, which remained setup state, and whether each is visible in the intended memory surface after sign-out and sign-in.
nodes.shippedSubset: Some chat onboarding preferences have a separate owner-confirmed PKM writer.
nodes.unmet: Onboarding state is not an admitted Live Memory source or full action log.

nodes.title: Connection and consent lifecycle
nodes.want: my connections, requests, approvals, revocations and disconnects to update private memory
nodes.acceptance: Use two controlled accounts to connect, request, approve, revoke and disconnect. Inspect both owner projections after each commit. A partial read must retain prior state and mark unavailable; no contact-list row or counterpart profile may be copied.
nodes.shippedSubset: Bounded consent and established-connection snapshots plus selected committed hints.
nodes.unmet: No complete contacts history or every possible consent mutation signal is established by the journal.

nodes.title: Connected apps, contacts, mail and receipts
nodes.want: a reviewed source map to show what a connected provider contributed and when
nodes.soThat: connection status is not mistaken for captured provider data
substories: curated OAuth connect and revoke status
nodes.acceptance: Connect and revoke a curated test OAuth provider and inspect status-only readback. Separately test a real provider-mode receipt and contact change; mark those unavailable from Live Memory unless each has an admitted source contract and verified encrypted readback. Never retain OAuth tokens or raw mail content by implication.
nodes.shippedSubset: Curated OAuth status enters the inventory; receipt aggregates can follow a separate owner-confirmed Soul path.
nodes.unmet: Full contacts, general mail activity, individual receipts and custom connector data are outside the Live Memory inventory.

nodes.title: Payments, receipts and document handoffs
nodes.want: verified transactions and document transfer milestones to have accurate private status
nodes.soThat: I can later recall a payment or handoff without inventing it
nodes.acceptance: Run a real provider test-mode earning, requester checkout, refund and wallet action, then inspect authoritative rows and encrypted owner readback. Test a document share and a separate receipt. Record absent source contracts as gaps; do not use payment success as proof of document delivery.
nodes.shippedSubset: Document earnings, payout activity and requester document payment metadata have bounded adapters.
nodes.unmet: No complete receipt/transaction ledger, document body or general handoff history in the source inventory.

nodes.title: Location, PWM and specialist-agent activity
nodes.want: the data used by my location, world-model and specialist agents to be inspectable with source and time
nodes.soThat: the private agent can explain what it knows and what it cannot know
nodes.acceptance: Save and remove an actual Location record, approve or reject a PWM candidate, and complete a specialist-agent task. Check each existing authority and prove whether a corresponding Live Memory source record and agent-readable claim exists. A preview timing trace is not a personal memory event.
nodes.shippedSubset: Location PKM, PWM research/legacy preferences, and some agent traces each exist in separate boundaries.
nodes.unmet: No admitted Live Memory source or unified recall path for location, PWM or subagent activity.

nodes.title: Feed dismissal, sign-out and account deletion
nodes.want: a dismissed card or deleted fact to stay removed after sign-out and sign-in
nodes.soThat: the app does not revive information I removed
substories: zero-row dismissal does not falsely hide a card
account erasure removes derived projections and queued work
nodes.acceptance: Dismiss a real Feed card, sign out and back in, verify it remains hidden and the underlying financial or consent fact remains correct. Repeat a zero-row dismissal and controlled account erasure; inspect every store and in-flight generation fence.
nodes.shippedSubset: Feed dismissal has its own persistence; source inventory has verified tombstones and owner erasure hooks.
nodes.unmet: Feed dismissal itself is not a Live Memory event; cross-store erasure and late-work behavior lack a real-flow receipt in this audit.

nodes.title: Revocable capture while all owner clients are closed
nodes.want: admitted changes to reach encrypted memory without keeping my app open
nodes.soThat: memory is fresh when I return
substories: pause, revoke and delete fence in-flight work
nodes.acceptance: Pair a reviewed private runtime, close and lock every client, commit profile, consent and test-mode payment changes, and prove encrypted revision/readback and measured lag. Restart, replay, unpair and revoke during in-flight work. No generic server credential or cached browser key may act as owner authority.
nodes.shippedSubset: Hosted pilot review and encrypted-envelope primitives only.
nodes.unmet: No paired worker or closed-app ingestion consumer.

nodes.title: Auditable committed activity history
nodes.want: the important change sequence, including reversals and removals, to be reconstructable
nodes.soThat: a final snapshot does not hide what happened
nodes.acceptance: Commit A→B→C while every client is closed, then replay. Verify each admitted transition or explicitly report lost intermediate state and retention cutoff; a gap or duplicate must repair from authority without fabricating history.
nodes.shippedSubset: Metadata-only owner/kind hints and up to 2,048 observed encrypted revisions.
nodes.unmet: Intermediate values while closed cannot be reconstructed; both journals are bounded, and hints lack source ID/value/revision.

nodes.title: Measured freshness and truthful current state
nodes.want: to see when each source was verified and whether memory is delayed
nodes.soThat: I do not act on stale information
substories: stale status when browser timer suspends
retry and resource budget by source
nodes.acceptance: Measure source commit, hint read, snapshot verification, encrypted write/readback and Profile display across focus, offline, hidden-tab, cap and failure conditions. The UI must stop saying current when source verification expires; publish a target only after measuring it.
nodes.shippedSubset: A 60-second browser wake, per-source five-minute verification age and incomplete status are coded.
nodes.unmet: No measured end-to-end latency target or completed real-source evidence; cached current status does not re-evaluate per-kind verification age.

nodes.title: Provenance-aware graph and private-agent recall
nodes.want: my private agent to answer from current, verified claims across admitted sources
nodes.soThat: it distinguishes known, missing, stale, conflicting and removed facts
nodes.acceptance: Change a name, tombstone a source record, introduce conflicting evidence, and ask the private agent. Verify cited source/revision, correct temporal status and an unknown answer where no eligible fact exists. PWM candidates remain outside owner facts until review.
nodes.shippedSubset: An in-memory owner fact index has field nodes, provenance, freshness, tombstone and conflict states; One chat reads separate Soul Markdown.
nodes.unmet: No unified runtime claim/evidence graph or automatic agent retrieval from the Live Memory index.

nodes.title: Price only an approved, available answer subset
nodes.want: an age/sex/location request to disclose available, missing and unavailable scopes separately
nodes.soThat: no one pays for guessed or absent information
substories: freeze and recheck exact scopes and price
nodes.acceptance: With explicit sex and saved location but no valid age source, request all three. Confirm sex/location are eligible, age is not recorded, owner approves only the exact subset and price, requester sees omissions before checkout, and no unapproved or unavailable value becomes chargeable.
nodes.shippedSubset: Exact approved scope slices, rechecks, and paid-answer pipeline exist separately from general Live Memory inventory.
nodes.unmet: Real two-account provider-mode acceptance and live composer availability remain unverified here; Live Memory inclusion alone does not authorize an answer.

nodes.title: Every durable feature declares its memory impact
nodes.want: a CI contract that requires authority, signal, bounded snapshot, exclusions and tests
nodes.soThat: new durable information is never silently assumed to be captured
nodes.acceptance: Submit a feature PR with one durable owner write and no valid memory declaration: CI fails. Add a valid declaration and focused contract: CI passes. Then mutate the real source and verify commit→readback; the PR form alone cannot count as capture proof.
nodes.shippedSubset: PR template and static source/writer admission gate exist.
nodes.unmet: The static gate cannot prove all feature writes emit a hint or that real source flows complete.

nodes.title: Committed source hint journal
nodes.role: Owner-scoped, six-kind, metadata-only transactional hints; 2,048 retained events per owner, not an activity-value log.

nodes.title: Curated connector hint journal
nodes.role: Signals curated connector changes without copying credentials into memory.

nodes.title: Open/unlocked source bridge
nodes.role: Polls hints and authoritative snapshots only in an owner client with live vault key and token.

nodes.title: Encrypted source inventory and observed history
nodes.role: Current verified records/tombstones and bounded observed revisions, with encrypted replay cursors.

nodes.title: Owner-only in-memory fact lookup
nodes.role: Field predicate/value nodes with source revisions and verification status; no subject/claim/evidence graph edges or agent/sharing authority.

nodes.title: Derived Profile memory.md
nodes.role: Encrypted, source-linked owner presentation and approved-scope slice basis; derived from complete inventory and PKM domains.

nodes.title: Chat Soul Markdown
nodes.role: Encrypted one_memory.markdown, internally called Soul.md; One chat's supplied memory, distinct from Profile memory.md.

nodes.title: Legacy PWM preference document
nodes.role: Separate owner preference JSONB and subscription fabric; not a Live Memory or native research graph source.

nodes.title: Paired hosted private memory worker
nodes.role: Proposed scoped, revocable closed-app consumer; reviewed key-custody change is required before it can operate.

nodes.title: Live Memory source admission gate
nodes.role: Checks PR declaration, admitted source kinds and guarded projection writers; semantic source coverage still requires review and real-flow evidence.

nodes.title: No closed-app consumer
nodes.failure: No paired worker can decrypt, verify and commit memory after every owner client closes or locks.
nodes.proofNeeded: Closed-client real-source commit→encrypted readback, restart and in-flight revocation test.

nodes.title: Major source families are not admitted
nodes.failure: The inventory's seven kinds omit onboarding state, contacts, general mail/receipts, document handoffs, Feed dismissals, Location, PWM and agent activity.
nodes.proofNeeded: Per-source authority and consent decision, bounded snapshot, post-commit signal, encrypted readback and deletion test.

nodes.title: Metadata hints cannot reconstruct the action sequence
nodes.failure: Hints lack source ID/value/revision, and observed history records only changes verified by an unlocked client. Intermediate closed-app values are lost; 2,048-event retention is explicit.
nodes.proofNeeded: Multiple commits between wakes and rollover test with an explicit completeness boundary.

nodes.title: Internal journal-gap reset contract mismatch
nodes.failure: Backend returns resetRequired for a missing event inside the retained cursor range; client accepts reset only outside that range, catches the resulting error and delays repair to periodic scans.
nodes.proofNeeded: One cross-layer automated case using the backend's in-range gap response must force all-kind rescan without cursor advance.

nodes.title: No measured latency service level or expiry-safe current state
nodes.failure: 60-second browser polling and five-minute scan ages are scheduling rules, not a delivery guarantee. Session cache can show current after a hidden tab stops verifying sources.
nodes.proofNeeded: Commit→UI p50/p95/p99 by source and fake-time stale-state test at verification expiry.

nodes.title: Global completeness and finite caps amplify retries
nodes.failure: An unrelated failed kind blocks whole-inventory complete and cursor advance. Full-kind two-pass scans, 2,048-hint retention and source caps can drive repeated repair or persistent incomplete state.
nodes.proofNeeded: Mixed healthy/failing source and capacity/rollover tests with request-count, CPU, backlog and recovery measurements.

nodes.title: Memory authorities are fragmented for intelligent recall
nodes.failure: Profile source facts, Soul Markdown, legacy PWM and native PWM candidates have separate owners. The fact lookup has no claim/evidence graph edges, and One chat reads Soul rather than the Live Memory fact index.
nodes.proofNeeded: One reviewed fact with source/revision/conflict/tombstone survives projection and source-scoped agent query; unreviewed inference stays quarantined.

nodes.title: CI admission is static; real-source acceptance is unproven
nodes.failure: A checked PR declaration, source-kind allowlist and unit fixtures cannot prove every durable write was signalled or that a real provider/account journey reached encrypted readback and agent/UI retrieval.
nodes.proofNeeded: Privacy-safe per-source real-flow receipt: commit time, hint/recovery, verified read, encrypted write/readback revision, UI or agent state, negative control and measured lag.

targetPersonalGraphContract.purpose: A future owner-scoped projection for questions across admitted sources, not a second source of truth and not a grant.

nodeTypes.Subject: Verified owner or explicitly unresolved candidate identity
nodeTypes.Claim: Predicate, eligible value, valid time, current/deleted/stale/conflicted state
nodeTypes.EvidenceSource: Canonical source authority, owner and field policy
nodeTypes.SourceSnapshot: Stable source ID, revision, commit/observed/verified times and completeness
nodeTypes.EvidenceAssertion: A reviewed source span or field that supports or refutes one claim
nodeTypes.ReviewDecision: Owner approval, correction or retraction of a candidate
nodeTypes.AnswerRequest: Question, exact approved scope set, price terms and fulfillment state
nodeTypes.ProjectionVersion: Encrypted owner snapshot and dependency revisions

invariants: Only a canonical verified source or explicit owner review can publish a claim; a journal hint is only a wake signal.
A conflicting or stale source cannot silently replace a verified current value. A verified deletion is a durable tombstone.
Sex requires explicit recording; age requires a validated saved date of birth and an evaluation date. Neither is inferred from name, photo or chat style.
Owner-only encryption and source revisions precede graph projection. Consent, model processing and payment remain separate approvals.
No claim, source edge, topic label or graph membership alone grants another person access.

graphUseRule: This coverage graph describes product-story coverage and the proposed personal-graph ontology. It contains no personal values, grants or runtime authority. The targetPersonalGraphContract is design only; it is not a deployed personal knowledge graph.
